name: Morton Index Calculation via Byte-Lookup Table
definition: A method to compute the Morton (Z-order) curve index for a 3D voxel position (x, y, z) by using precomputed lookup tables for each byte of the coordinates, avoiding expensive bitwise interleaving operations.
summary: Morton Index Calculation via Byte-Lookup Table computes Z-order indices using precomputed tables to avoid expensive bitwise interleaving, optimizing specifically for chunked voxel data with a hard limit of 256 cubed voxels per chunk.
